title: C: GC (Simulated Mark-Sweep)
description: Simulate a mark-and-sweep garbage collector using a simple object model with reference tracking.

steps.title: Object Model and Allocation
steps.description: Define an `Object` struct with a marked flag, and pointers to up to 3 child objects. Write `Object* obj_new()` that allocates and registers an object. Track all objects in a global list.

verification.failureMessage: Before GC: 3 objects, After GC: 2 (orphan freed)
